intro: Shenyang is the centre of China’s old industrial northeast, and that history is still audible. The conventional freight lines fanning out to Fushun, Anshan and Dalian run analog dispatch radio around the clock, and the marshalling yards never stop. Taoxian handles a steady stream of domestic and Korean traffic on the international airband. The terrain is the flat Liaohe plain, so VHF carries well in every direction, and winter here is cold and dry enough to lift the whole band.
introz: 沈阳是中国老工业东北的中心，这段历史至今仍能听见。通往抚顺、鞍山、大连的普速货运线昼夜运行模拟无线列调，编组场从不停歇。桃仙机场在国际航空波段上有稳定的国内与韩日航班通话。地形是平坦的辽河平原，各方向 VHF 传播都好；这里的冬天冷而干燥，足以把整个频段抬起来。

stations.d: Taoxian is the northeast’s main hub and works a mix of domestic, Korean and Japanese traffic.
stations.dz: 桃仙是东北的主要枢纽，国内、韩国和日本航班混合。

stations.n: No continuous weather radio in China
stations.z: 中国没有连续气象广播

stations.d: The Liaohe plain is flat for a very long way. Simplex from any tall building covers the whole city.
stations.dz: 辽河平原一望无际。在任何高楼上直通都能覆盖整座城市。

stations.z: APRS 数据 · 一区与三区

stations.n: 无线列调 — conventional railway dispatch
stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速铁路调度
stations.d: This is the best conventional railway listening in China. The lines to Fushun, Anshan and Dalian are all analog and all busy.
stations.dz: 这是全中国最好的普速铁路收听地点。通往抚顺、鞍山、大连的线路全是模拟制式，而且都很忙。

stations.z: 高铁 · GSM-R 数字系统

stations.d: Liaoning traffic radio is the practical source for road conditions on the expressways out of the city in winter.
stations.dz: 冬天出城高速的路况，辽宁交通广播是最实用的来源。

stations.d: Close enough to the Korean peninsula and to Russia that the night-time medium wave band is genuinely international.
stations.dz: 离朝鲜半岛和俄罗斯都足够近，夜间中波频段是真正国际化的。

stations.d: Shenyang’s markets, workshops and construction sites are heavy users. Scan all twenty channels near the Tiexi district.
stations.dz: 沈阳的市场、车间和工地是这个频段的重度用户。在铁西区附近把 20 个信道扫一遍。
